description: React component implementing an admin authentication gate with UI feedback, debug panel, and integration with Supabase auth. It manages user session, profile fetching, and access control for admin users, including timeout handling and debug utilities.

classes.name: LoadingGate
classes.description: UI component showing a loading message during access check.

classes.name: Blocked
classes.description: UI component displaying access restriction or error message with retry option.

classes.name: AdminDebugPanel
classes.description: Debug panel showing current admin auth state for development purposes.

methods.description: Determines if debug panel should be shown based on environment variables.
